sources.title: How V7 gives AI agents institutional memory - OpenAI
sources.snippet: After building a widely used computer vision accessibility app together, Rizzoli and Edwardsson started V7 ⁠ in 2018 to help companies teach AI systems how their businesses work. V7 Go is an agentic platform to build mission critical workflows, and organize buried context into memory that agents can query and act on.
